conversation.text: How much will the company reimburse for tuition each year?

The company will reimburse up to **$5,250 per calendar year** for job-related courses or degree programs. 

To qualify for reimbursement:
* Courses require **pre-approval from your manager**.
* You must earn a grade of **B or better** (or "Pass" in a pass/fail course).
Thank you for the clear information on tuition reimbursement. Speaking of benefits, how many days of PTO do we get each year?
You receive **20 days of PTO per year**, which accrue on a monthly basis. Up to **5 unused days** can roll over to the next year.
That makes sense. Since we're on the topic of time off, how many sick days do we get each year, and do they roll over?
You receive **10 sick days per year**, and they **do not roll over** to the next year.
Thank you for confirming that! That covers all of my questions about time off and benefits. I appreciate your help!
